facts.fact: Neela leaves Kettamala after the new-moon dusk, rides a night and a day, and is taken at the first dusk. Her order to Muthu: if she is not back by first light on the second day, put Devan in a cart and start up the wood road and meet her on it. Muthu leaves at first light of day two and reaches the Resin House gate at the second dusk, the dusk of Neela's binding. Replaces F242.

Chathu knows a cart is coming to his gate tonight and that Vellan will wait for it. Neela realises only she and Muthu heard the order, so the inside informant (F220) reaches Chathu fast; she recalls Muthu's stillness and 'I won't'. Chathu answers only 'A house pays its debts in news, child.'

Chathu recalled Ammu to carry the resin pot at dusk and to stand watch as a lesson after the covered scent-posts were found out. In the kennels her lips begin the tappers' verse 'the name given back' and stop.
Devan has held a river pebble in his cheek on the resin nights since the rampart (ch20 onward), not every resin night Neela has had.
